name: u1-chopper-resonance-tuner
title: Chopper Resonance Tuner for Snapmaker U1
author: Alexander Fedorov and Maksim Bolgov; Snapmaker U1 adaptation contributors
description: Packages Chopper Resonance Tuner for the Snapmaker U1 CoreXY motion system, including correctly configured 0.9-degree LDO X/Y motors. It calibrates the paired TMC2240 drivers with the stock LIS2DW accelerometer, uses the U1's 12.5 MHz driver clock, and creates standalone HTML reports without installing Python packages on the printer.
tagline: Measure U1 X/Y chopper settings with the stock accelerometer.
attributions: Chopper Resonance Tuner and the bundled gcode_shell_command extra are GPL-3.0-licensed upstream work by their named authors. The Snapmaker U1 adaptation adds Bespok3d packaging, U1-specific CoreXY/TMC2240/LIS2DW behavior, a dependency-free report generator, compatibility tests, and safety documentation. Complete corresponding source is available in the public fork.
